cli.rationale: CLI: macOS 13+, Windows 10 1809+/Server 2019+, Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 10+, Alpine 3.19+, x64 or ARM64, 4 GB+ RAM; the built-in sandbox works on macOS, Linux and WSL2 only. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code desktop, Claude Code web/mobile, Claude Code IDE extensions. claude-code.rationale: Claude Code embeds its own harness and runs Claude models only. Providers: Anthropic (subscription or Console), Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, and gateways that expose an Anthropic-format API. Anthropic does not support routing to non-Claude models and the docs state that workers in every multi-agent mode are Claude sessions. Scope: Claude Code CLI.

codex.rationale: The documentation explicitly says every multi-agent worker is a Claude session. MCP tool access and configuration import do not run this other harness natively.

byo-subscription.rationale: Pro/Max/Ultra/Team/Enterprise include Code, sharing subscription usage with other Claude clients. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code desktop, Claude Code web/mobile, Claude Code IDE extensions.

local.rationale: The CLI runs on the user machine. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code web/mobile.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Cloud sessions run in Anthropic-managed Ubuntu 24.04 VMs. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code web/mobile.

own-server.rationale: Team/Enterprise public beta can execute sessions on customer-run infrastructure while Anthropic hosts the control plane.

vm.rationale: The cited cloud-environments page states that each Anthropic-hosted session gets a fresh virtual machine. This is scoped to managed cloud sessions. Rechecked the cited text after the RUN-02 citation change; no VM was run.

worktree.rationale: The worktrees page rechecked November 7 documents --worktree creating a separate Git checkout and branch, plus subagent isolation: worktree. This establishes a documented file-isolation option, without treating a worktree as a security sandbox.

container.rationale: The documented dev-container and custom Docker/OCI options isolate the whole Claude Code process. They require user configuration.

parallel-runs.rationale: Several sessions can run at once in separate terminals or worktrees, as background sessions in agent view, or as cloud sessions; Remote Control server mode defaults to 32 concurrent sessions. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code web/mobile.

coordinator.rationale: Delegation is inspectable through subagents (own model, effort, tools), agent teams, cross-session messaging and dynamic workflows. All workers are Claude sessions; agent teams are experimental and off by default. Scope: Claude Code CLI.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Cloud scheduled tasks are shared across web/Desktop/CLI for one account; /schedule creates them and /routines remains an alias. Local Desktop tasks require app and host awake; /loop is session-scoped. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code desktop, Claude Code web/mobile, Claude Code IDE extensions.

roles.rationale: Owners configure shared cloud environments and defaults; admins govern settings; Enterprise lists role-based access with fine-grained permissioning. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code desktop, Claude Code web/mobile, Claude Code IDE extensions.

sso.rationale: SSO is listed for Team and Enterprise; Claude apps gateway sign-in uses corporate SSO. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code desktop, Claude Code web/mobile, Claude Code IDE extensions.

pr-workflow.rationale: Claude creates pull requests when asked. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code web/mobile.

review-ui.rationale: /diff reviews working-tree changes; Desktop and IDE show diffs. Scope: Claude Code CLI.

license.rationale: LICENSE.md: "© Anthropic PBC. All rights reserved. Use is subject to Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service." The GitHub API reports no license for the repository. Scope: Claude Code CLI.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: DISABLE_TELEMETRY, DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC opt out. Scope: Claude Code CLI.

free-tier.rationale: Pricing page lists Claude Code as No for the Free plan. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code desktop, Claude Code web/mobile, Claude Code IDE extensions.

laptop-independent.rationale: Cloud sessions keep running. Remote Control reconnects after a brief network loss; in server mode Claude Code gives up after roughly 10 minutes and the claude remote-control process exits. Local sessions need the machine. Scope: Claude Code CLI, Claude Code web/mobile.

issue-tracking.rationale: Native Task tools persist task records with pending, in-progress and completed states separately from sessions. The facet accepts persistent tasks; a full backlog is not claimed.

free-plan.rationale: Free plan excludes Claude Code; all paid plans include it.

usage-based.rationale: Paid usage credits past plan limits or Console API billing.

byok.rationale: Anthropic Console API key and cloud-provider credentials.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete first-party plan comparison lists paid subscriptions including Code.

compute.rationale: The cloud session documentation explicitly states that subscription cloud sessions have no separate compute charge.

one-time.rationale: The complete published plan list has recurring subscriptions and API usage; it omits a one-time license purchase.

paid-from.rationale: Pro $20 monthly. Rechecked against the eligible finding on 2026-11-13: this paid offering remains distinct from no paid plan. Original source-check date retained; independent mapping review cleared for the revised definition.

starting-price.rationale: The documented lowest monthly subscription including Claude Code is Pro at USD 20. Free excludes Code; API/provider billing remains an alternative route.

self-hosting.rationale: The installed CLI hosts the complete coding loop/tools/context process on user infrastructure, with external model inference. This excludes the hosted web/desktop control plane and its self-managed worker feature.
